title: Workshop: People and family
goal: Read and write a description of a family, understand people described in announcements and messages, and add new words for relatives and looks.

items.note: Always plural: des lunettes. You will also often hear porter des lunettes: Elle porte des lunettes.
Same form for men and women.

steps.title: A message for the babysitter
steps.intro: A new situation: Camille needs a babysitter on Saturday. She writes to Mei to describe everyone at home.

blocks.title: Camille's email to Mei
blocks.fr:
Bonjour Mei,

Merci beaucoup ! Samedi soir, à 18 h, tu es avec mes enfants. Voici ma famille.

Mon mari s'appelle Marc. Il est grand et mince, il a les cheveux courts et une barbe. Il est très drôle. Nous avons trois enfants. Ma fille, Léa, a dix ans. Elle est rousse et elle a des lunettes. Elle est sérieuse et très sportive : elle adore le hockey ! Mes fils, Hugo et Noé, ont six ans. Ce sont des jumeaux. Ils sont petits et blonds, et très drôles… mais pas toujours gentils !

Samedi, ma mère est aussi à la maison. C'est la grand-mère des enfants. Elle est âgée : elle a soixante-dix-huit ans. Elle est un peu timide, mais très gentille. Elle parle français et un peu anglais. Le grand-père, mon père, habite à Moncton. Mes parents sont divorcés.

Mon neveu, Samuel, arrive à 19 h. C'est le fils de ma sœur. Il a quinze ans et il est très sympa avec les jumeaux.

Merci et à samedi !
Camille
blocks.en:
Hello Mei,

Thank you very much! On Saturday evening, at 6 p.m., you are with my children. Here is my family.

My husband's name is Marc. He is tall and slim, he has short hair and a beard. He's very funny. We have three children. My daughter, Léa, is ten. She has red hair and she wears glasses. She is serious and very sporty: she loves hockey! My sons, Hugo and Noé, are six. They are twins. They are small and blond, and very funny… but not always nice!

On Saturday, my mother is at home too. She is the children's grandmother. She is elderly: she is seventy-eight. She's a little shy, but very kind. She speaks French and a little English. The grandfather, my father, lives in Moncton. My parents are divorced.

My nephew, Samuel, arrives at 7 p.m. He's my sister's son. He's fifteen and he is very nice with the twins.

Thanks and see you Saturday!
Camille

blocks.explain: [[Elle est rousse et elle a des lunettes.]] Marc has a beard.
[[Mon neveu, Samuel… C'est le fils de ma sœur.]]

blocks.prompt: What do we learn about Camille's mother?
options: She is 78, a little shy but very kind.
She lives in Moncton with the grandfather.
blocks.explain: [[Elle est âgée : elle a soixante-dix-huit ans.]] The grandfather lives in Moncton: [[mes parents sont divorcés]].

blocks.title: Two questions for every sentence
blocks.body:
Describing people means asking two quick questions:

1. **Who or what is it?** The noun decides [[mon / ma / mes]] and the adjective ending: [[ma fille est rousse]], [[mes fils sont blonds]].
2. **Is it a quality or a thing you have?** A quality takes [[être]] ([[il est mince]]); a thing, an age or a body part takes [[avoir]] ([[il a une barbe]], [[il a quinze ans]]).

blocks.title: New words for relatives and looks

blocks.body:
- [[Il a une barbe]] and [[Elle a des lunettes]]: **avoir**, like hair and eyes. Never *il est une barbe*. (For glasses, [[Elle porte des lunettes]] is also very common.)
- [[roux]] → [[rousse]] and [[sportif]] → [[sportive]]: these endings change more than just **-e**. Learn both forms.
- [[ma grand-mère]], [[mon grand-père]]: the possessive follows [[mère]] and [[père]]. The plural is [[les grands-parents]].
- [[le fils]]: the **s** is pronounced, *fiss*.

- In Québec, a babysitter is often [[une gardienne]] (or [[un gardien]]), and babysitting is [[garder les enfants]]. In France: [[une baby-sitter]].
- Hockey is a family sport in Canada, for girls as much as boys: [[Elle adore le hockey]] is a very normal sentence about a ten-year-old girl.
- Blended families are common. You will hear [[ma demi-sœur]] (half-sister) and [[le conjoint de ma mère]] (my mother's partner).

blocks.title: An announcement at a shopping centre
blocks.context: A security agent speaks over the speakers at a shopping centre in Laval.
blocks.fr: Attention, s'il vous plaît. Nous cherchons un petit garçon. Il s'appelle Adam, il a cinq ans. Il est petit et brun, il a les cheveux courts et les yeux marron. Il porte un manteau bleu. Il parle français et arabe. Ses parents sont à l'entrée principale. Merci beaucoup.
blocks.en: Attention, please. We are looking for a little boy. His name is Adam, he is five. He is small and dark-haired, he has short hair and brown eyes. He is wearing a blue coat. He speaks French and Arabic. His parents are at the main entrance. Thank you very much.

blocks.fr: Nous cherchons un petit garçon. Il s'appelle Adam, il a cinq ans. Il est petit et brun, il a les cheveux courts et les yeux marron.
blocks.en: We are looking for a little boy. His name is Adam, he is five. He is small and dark-haired, he has short hair and brown eyes.
blocks.explain: [[brun]], [[les cheveux courts]], [[les yeux marron]]. [[marron]] never changes.

blocks.fr: Il porte un manteau bleu. Il parle français et arabe. Ses parents sont à l'entrée principale.
blocks.en: He is wearing a blue coat. He speaks French and Arabic. His parents are at the main entrance.
blocks.explain: [[Ses parents]] = his parents. [[ses]] because [[parents]] is plural.

blocks.title: Raj talks about his grandparents
blocks.context: In his French class, Raj shows a photo of his grandparents in India.
blocks.fr: Voici mes grands-parents. Ils habitent à Delhi, en Inde. Mon grand-père a quatre-vingt-cinq ans. Il est grand et mince, il a une barbe blanche et des lunettes. Il est sérieux, mais très gentil. Ma grand-mère a quatre-vingt-deux ans. Elle est petite et très drôle. Et elle est sportive : elle marche tous les matins !
blocks.en: Here are my grandparents. They live in Delhi, in India. My grandfather is eighty-five. He is tall and slim, he has a white beard and glasses. He is serious, but very kind. My grandmother is eighty-two. She is small and very funny. And she's sporty: she walks every morning!

blocks.fr: Mon grand-père a quatre-vingt-cinq ans. Il est grand et mince, il a une barbe blanche et des lunettes.
blocks.en: My grandfather is eighty-five. He is tall and slim, he has a white beard and glasses.
blocks.explain: [[quatre-vingt-cinq]] = 4 × 20 + 5 = 85.

blocks.fr: Il est sérieux, mais très gentil.
blocks.en: He is serious, but very kind.
blocks.explain: [[sérieux]] + [[gentil]], linked with [[mais]].

blocks.fr: Ma grand-mère a quatre-vingt-deux ans. Elle est petite et très drôle. Et elle est sportive : elle marche tous les matins !
blocks.en: My grandmother is eighty-two. She is small and very funny. And she's sporty: she walks every morning!
blocks.prompt: Why does Raj say his grandmother is sporty?
blocks.explain: [[sportive]] (feminine): [[elle marche tous les matins]].

blocks.fr: Ma nièce est rousse et elle a des lunettes.
blocks.explain: rousse: feminine of roux. des lunettes is always plural.

blocks.fr: Mon grand-père a une barbe blanche.
blocks.explain: grand-père has a hyphen and a grave accent.

steps.title: Mixed practice
steps.intro: Eight questions on this unit and four that mix in Units 1 to 3.

blocks.explain: [[grand-mère]] is feminine and starts with a consonant → [[ma]].

blocks.prompt: My nephew is tall and slim.
accept: Mon neveu est grand et mince.
blocks.explain: Quality → **être**; [[mince]] doesn't change.

blocks.en: Léa has red hair and is sporty.
blocks.explain: [[roux]] → [[rousse]] for a woman.

blocks.prompt: He has a beard and glasses.
options: Il a une barbe et des lunettes.
Il est une barbe et des lunettes.
Il a un barbe et des lunettes.
Il a une barbe et une lunettes.
optionFeedback: Things you have take avoir, not être.
lunettes is always plural: des lunettes.

blocks.explain: [[nièce]] is feminine → [[sa]], [[sportive]].

blocks.en: I have one nephew and two nieces.
blocks.explain: [[neveu]] is masculine; *a / one* → [[un]].

blocks.fr: Ses enfants ont les yeux bleus.
accept: Ces enfants ont les yeux bleus.
blocks.explain: [[ses]] because [[enfants]] is plural; [[ont]] is avoir with ils/elles. Eyes take [[les]]: [[les yeux bleus]].
Age with **avoir** (lesson 3.5); 85 = [[quatre-vingt-cinq]] (lesson 3.2).

blocks.en: My niece lives in the United States.
blocks.explain: Lesson 2.3: plural country → [[aux]].
[[dix-sept]] = 17 (lesson 3.1). 16 is [[seize]]; 70 is [[soixante-dix]].

blocks.prompt: You (a woman) meet Lucie's grandmother for the first time. What do you say?
options: Bonjour, madame. Ravie de vous rencontrer.
Bonjour, madame. Ravi de te rencontrer.
blocks.explain: Lesson 2.1: formal **vous** with an older person you don't know; a woman writes [[ravie]].
optionFeedback: Too casual for a first meeting with an older person.
Mixes te with madame, and a woman writes ravie.

blocks.prompt: A babysitter or a new friend will meet your family. Write a short message describing three people: who they are, their age, what they look like and what they are like.
blocks.promptFr: Décrivez trois personnes de votre famille.
checklist: Voici ma famille or a greeting
Three people with mon / ma / mes or son / sa / ses
Looks: être + adjective AND avoir + cheveux / yeux / barbe / lunettes
One personality adjective for each person
Correct endings for women and plurals

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Bonjour ! Voici ma famille. Mon mari, Karim, a trente-six ans. Il est grand et brun, et il a une barbe. Il est très drôle. Ma fille, Lina, a huit ans. Elle a les cheveux longs. Elle est sportive. Mon fils, Adam, a cinq ans. Il est petit et un peu timide.
models.en: Hello! Here is my family. My husband, Karim, is thirty-six. He is tall and dark-haired, and he has a beard. He's very funny. My daughter, Lina, is eight. She has long hair. She is sporty. My son, Adam, is five. He is small and a little shy.

models.label: Stronger model answer
models.fr: Bonjour Mei ! Voici trois personnes de ma famille. Ma sœur, Priya, a trente ans. Elle est petite et mince, elle a les cheveux longs et des lunettes. Elle est sérieuse, mais très gentille. Son fils, mon neveu Arjun, a douze ans. Il est très sportif et drôle. Et mon grand-père a quatre-vingt-cinq ans. Il a une barbe blanche. Il est âgé, mais il n'est pas timide !
models.en: Hello Mei! Here are three people in my family. My sister, Priya, is thirty. She is small and slim, she has long hair and glasses. She is serious, but very kind. Her son, my nephew Arjun, is twelve. He is very sporty and funny. And my grandfather is eighty-five. He has a white beard. He is elderly, but he's not shy!

blocks.prompt: Show a family photo (real or imagined) to a classmate. Present at least three people: who they are, where they live, their age, their looks and their personality. Use at least one new word: grand-père, grand-mère, neveu, nièce, barbe, lunettes, roux, mince or sportif.
checklist: Where one person lives (à / au / en)
Personality with très or un peu

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Voici ma famille. C'est ma grand-mère. Elle habite à Monterrey, au Mexique. Elle a soixante-dix ans. Elle est petite et très gentille. Ici, c'est mon frère, Diego. Il a vingt-huit ans. Il est grand et mince, et il a une barbe. Et voici ma nièce, Ana. Elle a quatre ans. Elle est rousse et très drôle !
models.en: Here is my family. This is my grandmother. She lives in Monterrey, in Mexico. She is seventy. She is small and very kind. Here, this is my brother, Diego. He is twenty-eight. He is tall and slim, and he has a beard. And here is my niece, Ana. She is four. She has red hair and she's very funny!

models.label: Stronger model answer
models.fr: Voici mes grands-parents et mes neveux. Mon grand-père a quatre-vingt-un ans. Il a une barbe et des lunettes. Il est sérieux, mais très sympa. Ma grand-mère est petite, mince et très sportive ! Ils habitent en France, à Lyon. Et là, ce sont mes neveux, Hugo et Noé. Ils ont six ans, ils sont blonds et drôles… mais pas toujours gentils !
models.en: Here are my grandparents and my nephews. My grandfather is eighty-one. He has a beard and glasses. He is serious, but very nice. My grandmother is small, slim and very sporty! They live in France, in Lyon. And there, those are my nephews, Hugo and Noé. They are six, they are blond and funny… but not always nice!

summary:
- Read and write a description of several family members with possessives, agreement, articles and être / avoir
- Understand people described in an announcement and a short talk
- Name more relatives and looks: [[le grand-père]], [[la nièce]], [[une barbe]], [[des lunettes]], [[rousse]], [[sportive]]
